title: The climb · people and the robot on the helix steps

reference.grammar: The hero: a record laid as steps that climb a helix under a lime sun, with a person and the robot on the top step and the model as a crystal.

techniques.name: Helix step

curl.label: Curl
curl.note: Radius of the helix the steps climb: smaller winds the flight tighter, larger opens it toward a straight stair.

turn.label: Turn
turn.note: Where on the helix the flight starts: turns the whole stair about its axis.

rise.label: Rise
rise.note: Height of each step, as a multiple of the page’s.

tread.label: Tread
tread.note: Depth of each step along the helix, as a multiple of the page’s.

block.label: Block size
block.note: Size of every step block against the spacing of the flight.

yaw.label: Yaw
yaw.note: Turns every block about its own vertical axis.

pitch.label: Pitch
pitch.note: How steeply the blocks are seen from above.

crystal.label: Crystal size
crystal.note: Size of each crystal the record sets into.

moment.label: Moment
moment.note: Where in its loop the figure is shown. 0 is the page’s own still.

techniques.implementation: A record is laid out as steps that climb a helix; a figure, a crystal or a state marker stands on a step. Drawn by the source page’s own code, with its stair, block, sun and crystal helpers given dials.

techniques.name: Measured inks
techniques.implementation: solid ink pixels of each figure, read at full resolution, are clustered to five colors; a color is kept when it holds at least 4% of the ink.

techniques.name: Figure and ground
techniques.implementation: The ground is the most common border color of a figure; ink is every pixel more than 40 levels from it.

pass_order: flight · one block to an exchange, on the helix
